definitions.gloss: without exception; all; entirely; every single one
definitions.explanation: Indicates that something applies to every member of a group with no exceptions.

examples.japanese: お{菓子|かし}を{残|のこ}らず{食|た}べてしまった。
examples.english: I ate all the snacks without leaving any.

examples.japanese: {参加者|さんかしゃ}は{残|のこ}らず{集|あつ}まった。
examples.english: All the participants gathered without exception.

examples.japanese: {書類|しょるい}を{残|のこ}らず{確認|かくにん}した。
examples.english: I checked all the documents without missing any.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
From {残|のこ}る (to remain) + ず (classical negative suffix). Literally "without remaining" — nothing is left behind.

USAGE:
Often used with verbs of collection, consumption, or checking to emphasize completeness. Modifies the verb directly as an adverb.
- {残|のこ}らず{食|た}べる: to eat every last bit
- {残|のこ}らず{集|あつ}める: to collect all of them
- {残|のこ}らず{確認|かくにん}する: to check every single one

COMMON VARIANT:
- {一人|ひとり}{残|のこ}らず: every single person, without exception

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
- {全部|ぜんぶ}: all (most neutral, everyday)
- {全|すべ}て: all, everything (slightly more formal)
- ことごとく: each and every one (literary)
- {余|あま}すところなく: without omission (formal)
